info.title: Forge APIs (merged)
info.description: Single-file catalog of all Forge FastAPI services. Prefer the Scalar UI at `/api-docs/` (one document per service). Per-service Swagger remains at each service `/docs`. Colliding routes (e.g. multiple `/health`) are under `/_internal/{service}/`.
